study: COMMON ResNet family study, group l42fc (seed-0 checkpoint, 10k cache)

storage.rationale: 10000 x 1024 x 14 x 14 fp32 = 8.0 GB on disk (fp64 would be 16 GB); consumers use the fp64-read path (resnet_common_lib.open_xin/xin_chunk) and form all operators in float64. The fp32 file is the defined study input; see rounding_effect for the (recorded) difference to the unrounded fp64 forward.
storage.forward_dtype: float64 (full net and local layer4+fc path)

quadruple_common.operators: H = stacked im2col patches (feature units); C/D = stacked downstream preactivation derivatives through the real remaining network (activation-to-output units); rates sigma/sqrt(N), N=10000 examples
quadruple_common.normalization: unit Frobenius norm of the layer's W (conv) resp. [W|b] (fc) edit; ||.||_X = dataset RMS in absolute logit units; relX = ||.||_X / ||F(theta0)||_X (separate metric, recorded separately)
quadruple_common.threshold: T(i) exact: sigma <= 1e-9*sigma0, gap-10 recorded, direct re-measurement of null candidates; T(ii) approx: ABSOLUTE rate sigma/sqrt(N) <= 1e-3 PRIMARY (relX reading recorded); T(iii) visibility: relX drift <= 1e-3 tested brackets only

precision.operators: float64 (Grams accumulated on GPU fp64, eigendecomposition on CPU/LAPACK)
precision.jv: float64 contraction, validated against torch.func.jvp (batched fp64) per layer
precision.battery_actual: float32 batched forwards from the edited layer through the real downstream, validated in fp64 on the validation subset (recorded per layer); frozen = F0 + r*Jv exactly (fp64)
